mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_oper_log (title, business_type, method, request_method, operator_type, oper_name, oper_url, oper_ip, oper_location, oper_param, json_result, status, error_msg, oper_time, create_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{businessType}, #{method}, #{requestMethod}, #{operatorType}, #{operName}, #{operUrl}, #{operIp}, #{operLocation}, #{operParam}, #{jsonResult}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{operTime}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, business_type, method, request_method, operator_type, oper_name, oper_url, oper_ip, oper_location, oper_param, json_result, status, error_msg, oper_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM sys_oper_log ORDER BY oper_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
